(3) The scene shifts to an outdoor night setting where a man in a patterned shirt grills food on a charcoal barbecue next to a table where others eat, illuminated by the glow of a nearby swimming pool with blue neon lights. (4) Close-up shots feature sizzling beef ribs on a grill and a hand holding a bottle of Kirkland 12-year-old blended scotch whisky against the night background. (5) Daytime activities follow, showing a boy paddling a kayak in a narrow waterway and a girl floating in a pink inflatable donut in a pool adjacent to green rice fields.
